findings.title: og:image on all pages is an inline data:image/svg+xml URI
findings.evidence: Every route returns the same <meta property="og:image"> whose value is a data:image/svg+xml,<svg viewBox='0 0 200 200' ...> URI (brand navy #002D56, two white leaf/flame paths + a white circle).
findings.impact: Facebook/LinkedIn/X/Slack/WhatsApp will not render a preview image — link shares appear imageless, hurting the trust funnel for investors and EPC partners.
findings.root: The build injects a data-URI SVG instead of an absolute HTTPS raster URL.
findings.fix: Generate a real 1200×630 PNG/JPG (OG + Twitter) per route, host it, set <meta property="og:image"> to the absolute HTTPS URL, and add og:image:width/height/alt/type.

findings.title: Identical <title> and meta description on every route
findings.evidence: /, /contact, /projects, /technologies and /careers all return the same title "KKM International Group | Technology. Engineering. Infrastructure. Innovation." and the same lone site-wide description.
findings.impact: No per-page relevance, keyword cannibalisation, poor SERP snippets and low CTR.
findings.root: SPA renders content client-side with no route-level <head> management (no SSR/SSG/head library).
findings.fix: Route-level metadata via SSR/SSG or a head manager; unique title/meta/canonical/OG/Twitter per route, localised.

findings.title: Soft-404: unknown routes return HTTP 200 serving index.html
findings.evidence: /nonexistent-xyz-123 → 307 → 200, Content-Disposition "index.html", ETag W/"8b3159f02e60e8b7395ef0fd17abf5b7" identical to the homepage; the same class was confirmed for 30+ tested paths.
findings.impact: Crawlers index endless duplicates, users hit blank/dead pages and receive no error guidance.
findings.root: Catch-all rewrite to index.html with no route-match handler and no 404 status.
findings.fix: Real 404 route with a 404/410 status, helpful navigation and noindex; keep SPA routing but return the correct status at the edge/SSR.

findings.title: The API / serverless function is failing
findings.evidence: /api, /api/health and /api/contact all return HTTP 500 with header "X-Vercel-Error: FUNCTION_INVOCATION_FAILED" (region pdx1); the body is the ~96-byte Vercel default error page.
findings.impact: If the contact/inquiry form posts here, submissions are silently lost — direct revenue and lead loss.
findings.root: A Vercel function throwing at runtime (missing env var, bad import, or no handler for GET).
findings.fix: Implement the route handler robustly: input validation, structured error handling + logging, a health endpoint that returns 200, and alerting.

findings.title: Evidence Registry cites downloadable .pdf files that do not resolve
findings.evidence: /EVD-CORP-REG-384054.pdf returns HTTP 200 but Content-Type text/html, filename="index.html" (the SPA fallback) — the PDFs are missing.
findings.impact: Undermines the whole Evidence Registry credibility premise — cited proof is not retrievable.
findings.root: Evidence documents are referenced as filenames but were never deployed or linked.
findings.fix: Host evidence PDFs at stable URLs, link each claim's Evidence Ref to the actual document, and return 404 for missing ones.

findings.title: Untranslated i18n keys leak into production on /careers
findings.evidence: The "Hear From Our Team" testimonials render literally "Emp_Testimonial_1_Quote", "Emp_Testimonial_1_Role", … "Emp_Testimonial_3_Role".
findings.impact: Looks broken/unfinished and damages credibility with candidates and partners.
findings.root: Missing translation entries plus no fallback handling.
findings.fix: Supply real testimonial quotes/roles; add a fallback so a missing key never renders raw; add a lint/CI check for missing keys.

findings.title: Random third-party placeholder images (picsum.photos) used as real content
findings.evidence: /technologies GMEL Vision & Navigator images and all 4 /insights article images use picsum.photos/seed/… (e.g. https://picsum.photos/seed/gmel-vision-app/600/400).
findings.impact: Unprofessional, non-deterministic (images change), external dependency and co-branding risk.
findings.root: Placeholder assets were never replaced.
findings.fix: Replace with owned, optimised imagery or on-brand generated visuals; remove picsum.

findings.title: Contact backend broken behind a 24-hour response promise
findings.evidence: The /contact page states "We usually respond within 24 hours" and "Inquiries are automatically routed to the appropriate internal department…", while /api/contact returns HTTP 500.
findings.impact: Inquiries may never arrive; the SLA promise cannot be met; leads are lost.
findings.root: The same broken function plus no verified email/CRM pipeline.
findings.fix: Implement and monitor the submission pipeline end-to-end (store + email + CRM) and add success/error UI states with retry.

findings.title: Interactive components are stubbed/disabled in production
findings.evidence: /contact shows "Interactive Map Disabled in Preview"; /technologies shows "🌐 3D-Inspired Interactive Subsurface Architecture", a "1 / 6" carousel and an "Interactive Technology Map".
findings.impact: Promised interactivity is missing; users on some environments see dead UI with no graceful fallback.
findings.root: Preview-only guards and unfinished interactive components were shipped.
findings.fix: Ship working components with static fallbacks, accessible controls, keyboard support and reduced-motion handling.

findings.title: apex→www uses a 307 Temporary Redirect (double hop)
findings.evidence: Chain: scheme-less host → HTTP/1.0 308 → https://kkm-intl.org/ → HTTP/1.1 307 Temporary Redirect → https://www.kkm-intl.org/ (200).
findings.impact: Temporary redirects don't consolidate ranking signals as strongly; the extra hop adds latency.
findings.root: Default Vercel redirect configuration.
findings.fix: Configure a single 308 permanent apex→www redirect (one hop) and self-canonicalise to the www host.

findings.title: Missing security headers
findings.evidence: Responses lack Content-Security-Policy, X-Frame-Options, X-Content-Type-Options, Referrer-Policy and Permissions-Policy; only Strict-Transport-Security is present.
findings.impact: Increased XSS/clickjacking/MIME-sniffing exposure; no referrer or privacy control.
findings.root: No headers configuration.
findings.fix: Add CSP (report-only first), X-Frame-Options/frame-ancestors, X-Content-Type-Options: nosniff, Referrer-Policy: strict-origin-when-cross-origin and Permissions-Policy.

findings.title: HTML and assets served with Access-Control-Allow-Origin: *
findings.evidence: 200 responses for "/" and static assets include "Access-Control-Allow-Origin: *".
findings.impact: Overly permissive CORS; any origin can read responses.
findings.root: Blanket CORS set for public assets.
findings.fix: Restrict CORS to trusted origins for anything non-public; keep public assets cacheable but scoped.

findings.title: HSTS present but without includeSubDomains or preload while subdomains exist
findings.evidence: Strict-Transport-Security: max-age=63072000 (no includeSubDomains, no preload), while gmel.vision.kkm-intl.org and gmel.navigator.kkm-intl.org are active.
findings.impact: Subdomains are not forced to HTTPS via HSTS.
findings.root: Partial HSTS configuration.
findings.fix: Add includeSubDomains (and preload only after an audit) once all subdomains are HTTPS-ready.

findings.title: A single hero image is served unoptimised at ~690 KB
findings.evidence: /images/gino-ayyoubian.jpg → image/jpeg, Content-Length 705,881 bytes (~690 KB).
findings.impact: Heavy LCP candidate; slow on mobile/Iranian networks.
findings.root: No image optimisation pipeline or responsive formats.
findings.fix: Serve AVIF/WebP with responsive srcset/sizes, correct dimensions, lazy-load below the fold, and use a CDN image transformer.

findings.title: HTML served with public, max-age=0, must-revalidate; assets unverifiable
findings.evidence: Cache-Control: public, max-age=0, must-revalidate on HTML; hashed static assets could not be inspected (raw HTML unavailable).
findings.impact: Potential revalidation of cacheable assets adds latency.
findings.root: Default Vercel static caching.
findings.fix: Set long-lived immutable caching for content-hashed assets, keep short revalidation for HTML, and add stale-while-revalidate.

findings.title: Very low indexation
findings.evidence: Web search for "site:kkm-intl.org" returns only the homepage (1 result); a brand query returns 1 result.
findings.impact: Near-zero organic discoverability despite a real sitemap.
findings.root: Client-only rendering + thin/duplicated meta + possibly an unreferenced sitemap give crawlers little to index.
findings.fix: Prerender/SSR content routes, add unique metadata and internal linking, submit the sitemap to Search Console, and add structured data.

findings.title: Key IA nodes absent as real pages
findings.evidence: /divisions, /team, /privacy, /terms, /faq, /services and /solutions all fall through to the SPA catch-all fallback (HTTP 200, no content).
findings.impact: Visitors and crawlers dead-end; divisions/capabilities are not discoverable.
findings.root: Routes referenced/expected but not implemented.
findings.fix: Implement the missing pages or remove dead links; enforce a route manifest and return 404 for unknown paths.

findings.title: /news, /investors and /downloads resolve but return no content
findings.evidence: All three return HTTP 200 with no extractable body.
findings.impact: Audience-targeted destinations (press, investor, downloads) are dead.
findings.root: Empty or canvas-only routes / unfinished pages.
findings.fix: Populate or remove; make them crawlable and content-rich, or return 404.

findings.title: No Persian routes resolve; manifest lang is en-only; no hreflang observed
findings.evidence: /fa and /fa-IR fall through to the catch-all; the PWA manifest declares lang "en"; no hreflang was observable.
findings.impact: The expected Persian/English bilingual audience is effectively English-only.
findings.root: No i18n routing or localisation layer wired.
findings.fix: Add locale-prefixed routes (/fa, /en) with hreflang alternates, RTL layout for Persian, localised metadata and a language switcher.

findings.title: Duplicate content across alias routes with no canonical
findings.evidence: /about and /about-us; /contact and /contact-us; /sustainability and /esg render the same content with no canonical.
findings.impact: Duplicate-content dilution and inconsistent linking.
findings.root: Multiple URLs for one page without canonicalisation.
findings.fix: Pick one canonical URL each, 301 the aliases and set rel=canonical.

findings.title: No accessible legal pages
findings.evidence: /privacy and /terms fall through to the fallback; no cookie policy observed; the only "consent" is an overlay stating "By continuing, you agree…".
findings.impact: Data-protection/compliance exposure and a trust gap for enterprise/international clients.
findings.root: Legal pages were not built; consent is implied.
findings.fix: Publish Privacy, Terms, Cookie and Data-Processing pages; implement explicit cookie consent (banner + preferences) with regional handling.

findings.title: Inconsistent claim taxonomy between /sustainability and /evidence
findings.evidence: /sustainability says "four audited categories: Verified, Internal, Estimated, and Demonstration", while /evidence defines a "7-tier" Levels A–G system.
findings.impact: Confusing governance story; harder for auditors/investors to follow.
findings.root: Two vocabularies for the same governance model.
findings.fix: Unify on one published taxonomy and cross-link "four categories" to the A–G levels.

findings.title: Implied consent is not GDPR-style valid consent
findings.evidence: The overlay says "By continuing, you agree to our data usage and verified reporting standards" but there are no cookie controls and no linked policy.
findings.impact: Implied consent is not valid consent under privacy regimes.
findings.root: Banner-as-consent.
findings.fix: Implement granular consent with opt-in for non-essential cookies and links to the policies.

findings.title: Contact spam protection is a static client-side arithmetic challenge (2 + 4 = ?)
findings.evidence: The /contact form shows "Security Question — 2 + 4 = ?" while the server endpoint returns HTTP 500.
findings.impact: Trivial to bypass with a bot, yet real submissions fail.
findings.root: Client-only static CAPTCHA plus a broken backend.
findings.fix: Server-side validation + rate limiting + honeypot/timestamp + (Turnstile/reCAPTCHA) as defence-in-depth, and a working endpoint.

findings.title: Two overlapping length indicators on the contact form
findings.evidence: The form shows both "1000 chars left" and "0 / 1000".
findings.impact: Minor visual redundancy/confusion.
findings.root: Two counters implemented.
findings.fix: Keep a single clear character counter with an accessible live region.

findings.title: Critical visuals depend on a third-party origin (picsum.photos) at view time
findings.evidence: /technologies and /insights load images from picsum.photos at runtime.
findings.impact: Adds external requests, potential latency/blocking, non-deterministic content and a privacy data flow.
findings.root: Placeholders shipped to production.
findings.fix: Self-host all media (see F-07) and remove third-party placeholder origins.

findings.title: The "4,600t CO₂e" figure appears without an inline evidence-level label
findings.evidence: /technologies shows "Measured Environmental Impact — 4,600t CO₂e" without an A–G chip, though the group's governance requires claims to carry a label.
findings.impact: Inconsistency with the stated Production Truth Layer.
findings.root: The metric is not wired to the registry labelling.
findings.fix: Render each metric with its evidence-level chip, sourced from the registry.

findings.title: Failures surface as Vercel's default 500 page with no monitoring
findings.evidence: /api* returns Vercel's stock 500 page; no custom error handling, no status page and no observable monitoring.
findings.impact: Users see an unbranded error; outages go unnoticed.
findings.root: No error boundaries/observability.
findings.fix: Custom 404/500 pages, structured logging + alerting (Sentry/Vercel logs), uptime monitoring, a status page and CI checks.

tickets.title: Per-route unique title, meta description and canonical
tickets.ac: Given any content route, When it is requested by a crawler, Then it returns a unique <title>, a unique meta description and a self-referential canonical, and no two routes share a title.
tickets.impl: Add an SSR/SSG head layer or a route-metadata manifest; render metadata server-side so crawlers see it before JS executes.
tickets.qa: Crawl every route; assert title/description uniqueness across the set; verify in Search Console URL Inspection.
tickets.dod: All routes carry unique metadata; an automated uniqueness test is green and deployed.

tickets.title: Real OG/Twitter 1200×630 images at absolute URLs
tickets.ac: Given a page is shared on LinkedIn/X/Facebook, When the crawler reads og:image, Then it gets an absolute HTTPS raster (1200×630) and a valid preview renders.
tickets.impl: Generate per-route 1200×630 PNG/JPG under /og/*; set og:image, twitter:image and og:image:width/height/alt/type.
tickets.qa: Run the Facebook Sharing Debugger, X Card Validator and LinkedIn Post Inspector on three routes.
tickets.dod: Every content route exposes a valid raster OG/Twitter image.

tickets.title: Proper 404 route with correct status and noindex
tickets.ac: Given an unknown path, When requested, Then the server returns HTTP 404, renders a branded page with navigation and sets noindex; known routes still return 200.
tickets.impl: Handle unmatched routes at the edge/SSR to emit 404; add a 404 view; only enter client routing after a valid match.
tickets.qa: Request 10 random paths and assert 404 + noindex; assert known routes stay 200.
tickets.dod: Soft-404 eliminated; unknown paths return 404.

tickets.title: Single 308 apex→www redirect + self-canonical
tickets.ac: Given a request to the apex or scheme-less host, When followed, Then it reaches https://www.kkm-intl.org/ in a single 308 hop and pages self-canonical to www.
tickets.impl: Configure a permanent redirect in the hosting config; set the canonical host to www.
tickets.qa: curl -I the apex; assert exactly one 308 hop to www.
tickets.dod: One-hop 308 redirect; canonicals target www.

tickets.title: Prerender/SSR content routes + submit sitemap
tickets.ac: Given a content route, When fetched without JS, Then the full body and head are present and the route appears in a valid, submitted sitemap.
tickets.impl: Add SSR/SSG prerendering; regenerate sitemap.xml from the route manifest; submit via Search Console.
tickets.qa: Disable JS and fetch routes; validate sitemap.xml; confirm indexing in Search Console.
tickets.dod: Inner routes indexable without JS; sitemap submitted.

tickets.title: hreflang FA/EN + locale-prefixed routes
tickets.ac: Given a page, When requested, Then en/fa/x-default alternates are emitted and /fa resolves with RTL.
tickets.impl: Emit hreflang link tags; wire /en and /fa routing from the locale manifest.
tickets.qa: Validate hreflang with an online validator; fetch /fa and assert dir=rtl.
tickets.dod: hreflang valid on all content routes.

tickets.title: Fix failing serverless function(s) /api*
tickets.ac: Given GET /api/health, When requested, Then it returns HTTP 200 JSON; POST /api/contact with a valid body returns 200.
tickets.impl: Read Vercel runtime logs, fix the throwing import/env var, implement method handling and structured error handling.
tickets.qa: curl each endpoint and assert 200; confirm no FUNCTION_INVOCATION_FAILED in logs.
tickets.dod: /api/health = 200; functions no longer throw.

tickets.title: End-to-end contact pipeline (validate→store→email→CRM) + success/error UI
tickets.ac: Given a valid submission, When posted, Then it is stored, emailed to the routed department and synced to CRM, returning 200 {ok:true,id}; invalid input returns 400.
tickets.impl: Implement validate/store/email/CRM steps; add success/error/retry UI states; emit structured logs.
tickets.qa: Submit via UI and API; confirm inbox + CRM receipt; exercise invalid and failure paths.
tickets.dod: A real submission is received end-to-end; UI shows honest success/error.

tickets.title: Health/status endpoint + custom 404/500 + alerting
tickets.ac: Given an unhandled error, When it occurs, Then a branded 500 renders and an alert fires; /api/health is monitored on an interval.
tickets.impl: Add error boundaries, a custom 500 page, an uptime monitor on /api/health and an alert channel.
tickets.qa: Force an error and confirm the branded page plus a received alert.
tickets.dod: Errors are branded; alerting verified.

tickets.title: CMS content model + API contracts
tickets.ac: Given the content API, When editors publish a claim/division/project, Then typed records are returned and an OpenAPI contract is published.
tickets.impl: Model claims/divisions/projects; publish /api/claims, /api/divisions; document the contract.
tickets.qa: Run contract tests against the schema; validate the level enum A–G.
tickets.dod: Content served from a typed model with a published contract.

tickets.title: Rate limiting + spam defence-in-depth
tickets.ac: Given more than 5 submissions/minute from one IP, When posted, Then 429 is returned; honeypot and too-fast submissions are dropped silently.
tickets.impl: Add a token-bucket (Redis/Upstash), a honeypot field, a timestamp check and optional Turnstile.
tickets.qa: Automate a burst and confirm 429; submit the honeypot and confirm the drop.
tickets.dod: Rate limiting and bot traps enforced server-side.

tickets.title: Performance budget + CI performance gate
tickets.ac: Given a build, When CI runs, Then it fails if the LCP-image or JS budget is exceeded.
tickets.impl: Define budgets, add Lighthouse CI, persist results per run.
tickets.qa: Intentionally break a budget and confirm CI fails.
tickets.dod: CI enforces the performance budget.

tickets.title: Host & link Evidence Registry PDFs; 404 missing
tickets.ac: Given a claim's Evidence Ref link, When clicked, Then the real PDF downloads as application/pdf; a missing file returns 404.
tickets.impl: Upload the cited PDFs to stable URLs; wire each claim link; return 404 for absent files.
tickets.qa: Click through all 14 claim references; assert PDF or 404 — none may serve index.html.
tickets.dod: All cited evidence resolves to its document.

tickets.title: Fix leaked i18n keys on /careers + missing-key fallback + CI lint
tickets.ac: Given /careers, When rendered, Then no raw keys appear; a missing key falls back to EN and CI fails when a key is absent.
tickets.impl: Add real testimonials, implement an EN fallback, add a CI key-diff check.
tickets.qa: Render /careers and assert no 'Emp_' strings; delete a key and confirm CI fails.
tickets.dod: No raw keys in production; CI guards regressions.

tickets.title: Replace picsum placeholders with owned optimised media
tickets.ac: Given any page, When loaded, Then no request targets picsum.photos and images are self-hosted AVIF/WebP.
tickets.impl: Produce owned imagery; replace every picsum URL; self-host.
tickets.qa: Search the DOM for picsum.photos (expect zero); measure reduced external requests.
tickets.dod: Zero third-party placeholder origins in production.

tickets.title: Unify claim taxonomy + label metrics on pages
tickets.ac: Given a metric or claim, When rendered, Then it carries an A–G evidence chip sourced from the registry and one taxonomy is published.
tickets.impl: Unify the four-category vs A–G vocabulary; render metric chips (e.g. the 4,600t CO₂e figure).
tickets.qa: Verify each metric carries a chip; cross-check taxonomy copy between /sustainability and /evidence.
tickets.dod: Single taxonomy; all metrics labelled.

tickets.title: Build missing pages (/divisions,/team,/faq) or remove dead links
tickets.ac: Given the navigation, When any link is activated, Then it resolves to a real page or is removed; no link lands on the fallback shell.
tickets.impl: Implement /capabilities, /divisions/{slug}, /team and /faq; enforce a route manifest.
tickets.qa: Crawl all nav links and assert none return an empty 200.
tickets.dod: No dead navigation links remain.

tickets.title: Populate or remove /news, /investors, /downloads
tickets.ac: Given these routes, When requested, Then each shows real content or returns 404/redirect.
tickets.impl: Build content or decommission; add kept routes to the sitemap.
tickets.qa: Fetch each route; assert content or 404.
tickets.dod: No empty 200 destinations.

tickets.title: Canonicalise alias routes + 301s
tickets.ac: Given /about-us, /contact-us, /esg, When requested, Then a 301 directs to the canonical and rel=canonical matches.
tickets.impl: 301 the aliases; set canonicals.
tickets.qa: curl each alias; assert 301 to the canonical.
tickets.dod: Aliases 301; canonicals consistent.

tickets.title: Image optimisation pipeline (AVIF/WebP/srcset/lazy)
tickets.ac: Given the hero image, When served, Then it is AVIF/WebP with srcset/sizes, correct dimensions and lazy-loading below the fold.
tickets.impl: Use a CDN transform or build-time encode; add responsive attributes.
tickets.qa: Inspect responses and bytes saved; confirm lazy-load behaviour.
tickets.dod: Hero image within budget; responsive images live.

tickets.title: Caching policy for hashed assets (immutable)
tickets.ac: Given a hashed asset, When requested, Then Cache-Control is immutable, max-age=31536000; HTML revalidates briefly with stale-while-revalidate.
tickets.impl: Add header rules per asset class.
tickets.qa: curl an asset and assert immutable; curl HTML and assert short revalidation.
tickets.dod: Correct caching per asset class.

tickets.title: Add security headers incl. CSP (report-only first)
tickets.ac: Given a response, When fetched, Then CSP (report-only), X-Frame-Options/frame-ancestors, nosniff, Referrer-Policy and Permissions-Policy are present.
tickets.impl: Add headers in the hosting config; start CSP as report-only and review reports before enforcing.
tickets.qa: Scan headers and assert presence; review CSP violation reports.
tickets.dod: Headers present; CSP clean or tightly limited.

tickets.title: Scope CORS
tickets.ac: Given a non-public endpoint, When called cross-origin, Then CORS is restricted to trusted origins.
tickets.impl: Replace ACAO:* with an explicit allow-list for anything non-public.
tickets.qa: Call cross-origin from an untrusted origin; expect denial.
tickets.dod: CORS scoped to trusted origins.

tickets.title: HSTS includeSubDomains after subdomain audit
tickets.ac: Given all subdomains serve HTTPS, When HSTS is set, Then includeSubDomains is present and preload is considered only post-audit.
tickets.impl: Audit subdomains, then extend the HSTS header.
tickets.qa: Assert the header; test a subdomain over HTTP redirects to HTTPS.
tickets.dod: HSTS extended safely across subdomains.

tickets.title: WCAG 2.2 AA audit + fixes
tickets.ac: Given the site, When audited, Then keyboard, focus order, ARIA, contrast, reduced motion and form labels pass, and interactive components operate by keyboard.
tickets.impl: Audit and remediate; add reduced-motion media queries; fix stubs and counters.
tickets.qa: Run automated + manual audits and a keyboard-only walkthrough.
tickets.dod: No WCAG 2.2 AA blockers; report attached.

tickets.title: Persian localization + RTL layout + language switcher
tickets.ac: Given /fa, When requested, Then content renders in Persian with dir=rtl, logical CSS mirrors the layout and the switcher reflects the locale.
tickets.impl: Add locale routing, message files, RTL styles and the switcher.
tickets.qa: Load /fa; verify RTL, no clipped glyphs and switcher state.
tickets.dod: Persian route live and correct.

tickets.title: Lead capture + inquiry qualification + analytics plan
tickets.ac: Given a submission, When received, Then it is qualified/routed and fires a conversion event, and a documented measurement plan exists.
tickets.impl: Add inquiry routing rules, GA4 events and KPIs.
tickets.qa: Submit test leads; confirm events and routing.
tickets.dod: Capture and events verified against the plan.

tickets.title: Publish Privacy/Terms/Cookie/DPA pages
tickets.ac: Given the footer, When a legal link is activated, Then a real legal page renders at /legal/*.
tickets.impl: Draft and publish legal pages; link them in the footer.
tickets.qa: Fetch each legal page; assert content and working footer links.
tickets.dod: Legal pages live and linked.

tickets.title: Cookie consent (granular, opt-in)
tickets.ac: Given a first visit, When non-essential cookies are off, Then nothing non-essential loads until opt-in and preferences are stored and changeable.
tickets.impl: Implement a consent banner with categories and preferences; gate scripts behind consent.
tickets.qa: Verify no non-essential cookies pre-consent; test toggles.
tickets.dod: Valid granular consent implemented.

tickets.title: Design-system rollout
tickets.ac: Given the components, When used, Then they consume tokens (type/space/colour) and match the documented inventory.
tickets.impl: Tokenise styles; refactor header/footer/cards/tables; document.
tickets.qa: Visual + accessibility regression on key pages.
tickets.dod: Tokens adopted across the site.

tickets.title: Replace interactive stubs with working, accessible components
tickets.ac: Given the carousel/map, When operated by mouse or keyboard, Then it works and respects reduced-motion with a static fallback.
tickets.impl: Rebuild the carousel and map with keyboard support, ARIA and reduced-motion fallbacks.
tickets.qa: Keyboard walkthrough; reduced-motion test.
tickets.dod: No stubbed or disabled UI in production.

tickets.title: DevOps: CI/CD checks, versioning, staging, backup/DR
tickets.ac: Given a pull request, When CI runs, Then build, header assertions and missing-key lint pass; a staging environment exists and backups/DR are documented.
tickets.impl: Add a CI pipeline, a staging environment and a backup/restore runbook.
tickets.qa: Open a failing PR and confirm CI blocks; restore from backup in staging.
tickets.dod: CI gates, staging and DR in place.

tickets.title: Structured data & rich results
tickets.ac: Given a content route, When rendered, Then valid Organization/BreadcrumbList (and Article) JSON-LD is present and passes the Rich Results Test.
tickets.impl: Add JSON-LD per template.
tickets.qa: Run the Rich Results Test on three routes.
tickets.dod: Structured data valid on key templates.
